## 执行总结

### 已完成的工作

1. **CP2**: 创建 Skills 目录结构和 README
   - 创建了 `.cursor/skills/` 目录
   - 创建了 Skills 索引和使用指南

2. **CP3**: 迁移功能领域1-3（代码质量、文档、架构）
   - 创建了 7 个 Skills：
     - `python-coding-standards/`
     - `file-size-limit/`
     - `single-responsibility/`
     - `documentation-standards/`
     - `doc-driven-development/`
     - `architecture-cognition/`
     - `architecture-design/`

3. **CP4**: 迁移功能领域4-5（任务管理、测试诊断）
   - 创建了 3 个 Skills：
     - `task-planning/`
     - `task-closure/`
     - `testing-and-diagnostics/`
   - 创建了 5 个 Scripts 框架

4. **CP5**: 迁移功能领域6-9（前端、规则、沟通、原则）
   - 创建了 4 个 Skills：
     - `frontend-development/`
     - `skill-management/`
     - `concise-communication/`
     - `project-principles/`
   - 创建了 2 个 Scripts 框架

5. **CP6**: 创建 Scripts 并整合 Commands
   - 创建了 7 个 Scripts 框架文件

6. **CP7**: 清理 Rules 和 Commands 目录
   - 删除了已迁移的 Rules 文件
   - 删除了已迁移的 Commands 目录
   - 更新了 README 说明迁移情况

7. **CP8**: 更新文档与索引
   - 更新了计划书状态表
   - 所有文档已同步

### 最终成果

- **14 个 Skills**：按功能领域组织，覆盖 9 个功能领域
- **7 个 Scripts**：整合了所有 Commands 的功能
- **统一体系**：实现了"上下文是认知，工作流是行为"的统一体系

### 下一步

Scripts 目前是框架文件，需要根据实际需求实现具体逻辑。所有 Skills 的 SKILL.md 文件已创建，可以直接使用。

Required&#96;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nYou can optionally include[additional directories](#optional-directories)such as&#96;scripts/&#96;,&#96;references/&#96;, and&#96;assets/&#96;to support your skill.\n## [​\n](#skill-md-format)\nSKILL.md format\nThe&#96;SKILL.md&#96;file must contain YAML frontmatter followed by Markdown content.### [​\n](#frontmatter-required)\nFrontmatter (required)\nReport incorrect code\nCopy\nAsk AI\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n&#96;---name:skill-namedescription:A description of what this skill does and when to use it.---&#96;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nWith optional fields:\nReport incorrect code\nCopy\nAsk AI\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n&#96;---name:pdf-processingdescription:Extract text and tables from PDF files, fill forms, merge documents.license:Apache-2.0metadata:author:example-orgversion:\u0026quot;1.0\u0026quot;---&#96;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n|Field|Required|Constraints|\n&#96;name&#96;|Yes|Max 64 characters. Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only. Must not start or end with a hyphen.|\n&#96;description&#96;|Yes|Max 1024 characters. Non-empty. Describes what the skill does and when to use it.|\n&#96;license&#96;|No|License name or reference to a bundled license file.|\n&#96;compatibility&#96;|No|Max 500 characters. Indicates environment requirements (intended product, system packages, network access, etc.).|\n&#96;metadata&#96;|No|Arbitrary key-value mapping for additional metadata.|\n&#96;allowed-tools&#96;|No|Space-delimited list of pre-approved tools the skill may use. (Experimental)|\n#### [​\n](#name-field)\n&#96;name&#96;field\nThe required&#96;name&#96;field:\n* Must be 1-64 characters\n* May only contain unicode lowercase alphanumeric characters and hyphens (&#96;a-z&#96;and&#96;-&#96;)\n* Must not start or end with&#96;-&#96;\n* Must not contain consecutive hyphens (&#96;--&#96;)\n* Must match the parent directory nameValid examples:\nReport incorrect code\nCopy\nAsk AI\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n&#96;name:pdf-processing&#96;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nReport incorrect code\nCopy\nAsk AI\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n&#96;name:data-analysis&#96;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nReport incorrect code\nCopy\nAsk AI\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n&#96;name:code-review&#96;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nInvalid examples:\nReport incorrect code\nCopy\nAsk AI\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n&#96;name:PDF-Processing# uppercase not allowed&#96;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nReport incorrect code\nCopy\nAsk AI\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n&#96;name:-pdf# cannot start with hyphen&#96;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nReport incorrect code\nCopy\nAsk AI\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n&#96;name:pdf--processing# consecutive hyphens not allowed&#96;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n#### [​\n](#description-field)\n&#96;description&#96;field\nThe required&#96;description&#96;field:\n* Must be 1-1024 characters\n* Should describe both what the skill does and when to use it\n* Should include specific keywords that help agents identify relevant tasksGood example:\nReport incorrect code\nCopy\nAsk AI\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n&#96;description:Extracts text and tables from PDF files, fills PDF forms, and merges multiple PDFs. Use when working with PDF documents or when the user mentions PDFs, forms, or document extraction.&#96;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nPoor example:\nReport incorrect code\nCopy\nAsk AI\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n&#96;description:Helps with PDFs.&#96;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n#### [​\n](#license-field)\n&#96;license&#96;field\nThe optional&#96;license&#96;field:\n* Specifies the license applied to the skill\n* We recommend keeping it short (either the name of a license or the name of a bundled license file)Example:\nReport incorrect code\nCopy\nAsk AI\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n&#96;license:Proprietary. LICENSE.txt has complete terms&#96;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n#### [​\n](#compatibility-field)\n&#96;compatibility&#96;field\nThe optional&#96;compatibility&#96;field:\n* Must be 1-500 characters if provided\n* Should only be included if your skill has specific environment requirements\n* Can indicate intended product, required system packages, network access needs, etc.Examples:\nReport incorrect code\nCopy\nAsk AI\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n&#96;compatibility:Designed for Claude Code (or similar products)&#96;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nReport incorrect code\nCopy\nAsk AI\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n&#96;compatibility:Requires git, docker, jq, and access to the internet&#96;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nMost skills do not need the&#96;compatibility&#96;field.\n#### [​\n](#metadata-field)\n&#96;metadata&#96;field\nThe optional&#96;metadata&#96;field:\n* A map from string keys to string values\n* Clients can use this to store additional properties not defined by the Agent Skills spec\n* We recommend making your key names reasonably unique to avoid accidental conflictsExample:\nReport incorrect code\nCopy\nAsk AI\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n&#96;metadata:author:example-orgversion:\u0026quot;1.0\u0026quot;&#96;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n#### [​\n](#allowed-tools-field)\n&#96;allowed-tools&#96;field\nThe optional&#96;allowed-tools&#96;field:\n* A space-delimited list of tools that are pre-approved to run\n* Experimental. Support for this field may vary between agent implementationsExample:\nReport incorrect code\nCopy\nAsk AI\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n&#96;allowed-tools:Bash(git:\\*) Bash(jq:\\*) Read&#96;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n### [​\n](#body-content)\nBody content\nThe Markdown body after the frontmatter contains the skill instructions. There are no format restrictions. Write whatever helps agents perform the task effectively.Recommended sections:\n* Step-by-step instructions\n* Examples of inputs and outputs\n* Common edge casesNote that the agent will load this entire file once it’s decided to activate a skill. Consider splitting longer&#96;SKILL.md&#96;content into referenced files.## [​\n](#optional-directories)\nOptional directories\n### [​\n](#scripts/)\nscripts/\nContains executable code that agents can run. Scripts should:\n* Be self-contained or clearly document dependencies\n* Include helpful error messages\n* Handle edge cases gracefullySupported languages depend on the agent implementation. Common options include Python, Bash, and JavaScript.### [​\n](#references/)\nreferences/\nContains additional documentation that agents can read when needed:\n* &#96;REFERENCE.md&#96;- Detailed technical reference\n* &#96;FORMS.md&#96;- Form templates or structured data formats\n* Domain-specific files (&#96;finance.md&#96;,&#96;legal.md&#96;, etc.)Keep individual[reference files](#file-references)focused. Agents load these on demand, so smaller files mean less use of context.### [​\n](#assets/)\nassets/\nContains static resources:\n* Templates (document templates, configuration templates)\n* Images (diagrams, examples)\n* Data files (lookup tables, schemas)## [​\n](#progressive-disclosure)\nProgressive disclosure\nSkills should be structured for efficient use of context:\n1. **Metadata**(\\~100 tokens): The&#96;name&#96;and&#96;description&#96;fields are loaded at startup for all skills\n2. **Instructions**(\u0026lt; 5000 tokens recommended): The full&#96;SKILL.md&#96;body is loaded when the skill is activated\n3. **Resources**(as needed): Files (e.g. those in&#96;scripts/&#96;,&#96;references/&#96;, or&#96;assets/&#96;) are loaded only when requiredKeep your main&#96;SKILL.md&#96;under 500 lines. Move detailed reference material to separate files.## [​\n](#file-references)\nFile references\nWhen referencing other files in your skill, use relative paths from the skill root:\nReport incorrect code\nCopy\nAsk AI\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n&#96;See [the reference guide](references/REFERENCE.md) for details.Run the extraction script:scripts/extract.py&#96;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nKeep file references one level deep from&#96;SKILL.md&#96;. Avoid deeply nested reference chains.## [​\n](#validation)\nValidation\nUse the[skills-ref](https://github.com/agentskills/agentskills/tree/main/skills-ref)reference library to validate your skills:\nReport incorrect code\nCopy\nAsk AI\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n&#96;skills-refvalidate./my-skill&#96;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nThis checks that your&#96;SKILL.md&#96;frontmatter is valid and follows all naming conventions.\n[What are skills?](https://agentskills.io/what-are-skills)[Integrate skills](https://agentskills.io/integrate-skills)\n⌘I",
  "url": "https://agentskills.io/specification"

  "markdown": "# anthropics/skills\n\nPublic repository for Agent Skills. Contribute to anthropics/skills development by creating an account on GitHub.\n\n⭐ 50,951 stars | 🍴 4.9k forks\n\n## Links\n\n- [Repository](https://github.com/anthropics/skills)\n- [Issues](https://github.com/anthropics/skills/issues)\n- [Pull Requests](https://github.com/anthropics/skills/pulls)\n\n## Files\n\n- [.claude-plugin/](https://github.com/anthropics/skills/tree/main/.claude-plugin)\n- [skills/](https://github.com/anthropics/skills/tree/main/skills)\n- [spec/](https://github.com/anthropics/skills/tree/main/spec)\n- [template/](https://github.com/anthropics/skills/tree/main/template)\n- [.gitignore](https://github.com/anthropics/skills/blob/main/.gitignore)\n- [README.md](https://github.com/anthropics/skills/blob/main/README.md)\n- [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](https://github.com/anthropics/skills/blob/main/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)\n\n## README\n\n\u003e Note: This repository contains Anthropic's implementation of skills for Claude. For information about the Agent Skills standard, see [agentskills.io](http://agentskills.io).\n\n# Skills\n\nSkills are folders of instructions, scripts, and resources that Claude loads dynamically to improve performance on specialized tasks. Skills teach Claude how to complete specific tasks in a repeatable way, whether that's creating documents with your company's brand guidelines, analyzing data using your organization's specific workflows, or automating personal tasks.\n\nFor more information, check out:\n\n- [What are skills?](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/12512176-what-are-skills)\n\n- [Using skills in Claude](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/12512180-using-skills-in-claude)\n\n- [How to create custom skills](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/12512198-creating-custom-skills)\n\n- [Equipping agents for the real world with Agent Skills](https://anthropic.com/engineering/equipping-agents-for-the-real-world-with-agent-skills)\n\n# About This Repository\n\nThis repository contains skills that demonstrate what's possible with Claude's skills system. These skills range from creative applications (art, music, design) to technical tasks (testing web apps, MCP server generation) to enterprise workflows (communications, branding, etc.).\n\nEach skill is self-contained in its own folder with a &#96;SKILL.md&#96; file containing the instructions and metadata that Claude uses. Browse through these skills to get inspiration for your own skills or to understand different patterns and approaches.\n\nMany skills in this repo are open source (Apache 2.0). We've also included the document creation \u0026 editing skills that power [Claude's document capabilities](https://www.anthropic.com/news/create-files) under the hood in the [&#96;skills/docx&#96;](/anthropics/skills/blob/main/skills/docx), [&#96;skills/pdf&#96;](/anthropics/skills/blob/main/skills/pdf), [&#96;skills/pptx&#96;](/anthropics/skills/blob/main/skills/pptx), and [&#96;skills/xlsx&#96;](/anthropics/skills/blob/main/skills/xlsx) subfolders. These are source-available, not open source, but we wanted to share these with developers as a reference for more complex skills that are actively used in a production AI application.\n\n## Disclaimer\n\nThese skills are provided for demonstration and educational purposes only. While some of these capabilities may be available in Claude, the implementations and behaviors you receive from Claude may differ from what is shown in these skills. These skills are meant to illustrate patterns and possibilities. Always test skills thoroughly in your own environment before relying on them for critical tasks.\n\n# Skill Sets\n\n- [./skills](/anthropics/skills/blob/main/skills): Skill examples for Creative \u0026 Design, Development \u0026 Technical, Enterprise \u0026 Communication, and Document Skills\n\n- [./spec](/anthropics/skills/blob/main/spec): The Agent Skills specification\n\n- [./template](/anthropics/skills/blob/main/template): Skill template\n\n# Try in Claude Code, Claude.ai, and the API\n\n## Claude Code\n\nYou can register this repository as a Claude Code Plugin marketplace by running the following command in Claude Code:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n/plugin marketplace add anthropics/skills\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThen, to install a specific set of skills:\n\n- Select &#96;Browse and install plugins&#96;\n\n- Select &#96;anthropic-agent-skills&#96;\n\n- Select &#96;document-skills&#96; or &#96;example-skills&#96;\n\n- Select &#96;Install now&#96;\n\nAlternatively, directly install either Plugin via:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n/plugin install document-skills@anthropic-agent-skills\n/plugin install example-skills@anthropic-agent-skills\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nAfter installing the plugin, you can use the skill by just mentioning it. For instance, if you install the &#96;document-skills&#96; plugin from the marketplace, you can ask Claude Code to do something like: \"Use the PDF skill to extract the form fields from &#96;path/to/some-file.pdf&#96;\"\n\n## Claude.ai\n\nThese example skills are all already available to paid plans in Claude.ai.\n\nTo use any skill from this repository or upload custom skills, follow the instructions in [Using skills in Claude](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/12512180-using-skills-in-claude#h_a4222fa77b).\n\n## Claude API\n\nYou can use Anthropic's pre-built skills, and upload custom skills, via the Claude API. See the [Skills API Quickstart](https://docs.claude.com/en/api/skills-guide#creating-a-skill) for more.\n\n# Creating a Basic Skill\n\nSkills are simple to create - just a folder with a &#96;SKILL.md&#96; file containing YAML frontmatter and instructions. You can use the template-skill in this repository as a starting point:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n---\nname: my-skill-name\ndescription: A clear description of what this skill does and when to use it\n---\n\n# My Skill Name\n\n[Add your instructions here that Claude will follow when this skill is active]\n\n## Examples\n- Example usage 1\n- Example usage 2\n\n## Guidelines\n- Guideline 1\n- Guideline 2\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThe frontmatter requires only two fields:\n\n- &#96;name&#96; - A unique identifier for your skill (lowercase, hyphens for spaces)\n\n- &#96;description&#96; - A complete description of what the skill does and when to use it\n\nThe markdown content below contains the instructions, examples, and guidelines that Claude will follow. For more details, see [How to create custom skills](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/12512198-creating-custom-skills).\n\n# Partner Skills\n\nSkills are a great way to teach Claude how to get better at using specific pieces of software. As we see awesome example skills from partners, we may highlight some of them here:\n\n- Notion - [Notion Skills for Claude](https://www.notion.so/notiondevs/Notion-Skills-for-Claude-28da4445d27180c7af1df7d8615723d0)",

Agent Skills\nAgent Skills 是一个用于为AI 智能体扩展专门能力的开放标准。Skills 将特定领域的知识和工作流封装起来，智能体可以调用这些Skills 来执行特定任务。## [什么是技能？\n](#)\n技能是一个可移植、支持版本控制的包，用于让Agent 学会如何执行特定领域的任务。技能既可以包含说明性指令，也可以包含Agent 可运行的脚本或代码。可移植技能适用于任何支持Agent Skills 标准的Agent。\n受版本控制技能以文件形式存储，可以在你的代码仓库中追踪其变更，或通过GitHub 仓库链接进行安装。可执行技能可以包含脚本和代码，由Agent 执行以完成任务。渐进式技能按需加载资源，使上下文使用更加高效。## [技能的工作原理\n](#-1)\nCursor 启动时，会自动从技能目录中发现并加载技能，并将它们提供给Agent 使用。Agent 会看到所有可用技能，并根据当前上下文决定何时调用它们。你也可以在Agent 对话中输入&#96;/&#96;并搜索技能名称来手动调用技能。\n## [技能目录\n](#-2)\n技能会自动从以下位置加载：|位置|作用域|\n&#96;.cursor/skills/&#96;|项目级|\n&#96;.claude/skills/&#96;|项目级（兼容 Claude）|\n&#96;.codex/skills/&#96;|项目级（兼容 Codex）|\n&#96;\\~/.cursor/skills/&#96;|用户级（全局）|\n&#96;\\~/.claude/skills/&#96;|用户级（全局，兼容 Claude）|\n&#96;\\~/.codex/skills/&#96;|用户级（全局，兼容 Codex）|\n每个技能应为一个包含&#96;SKILL.md&#96;文件的文件夹：\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n&#96;.cursor/└── skills/└── my-skill/└── SKILL.md&#96;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n技能还可以包含脚本、参考文件和资源等可选目录：&#96;&#96;&#96;\n&#96;.cursor/└── skills/└── deploy-app/├── SKILL.md├── scripts/│ ├──deploy.sh│ └──validate.py├── references/│ └──REFERENCE.md└── assets/└── config-template.json&#96;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n## [SKILL.md 文件格式](#skillmd)\n每个Skill 都在带有YAML 前置信息（frontmatter）的&#96;SKILL.md&#96;文件中定义：\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n&#96;---name: my-skilldescription: 简要描述此技能的功能及使用时机。---# 我的技能为Agent 提供的详细指令。## 使用时机- 在以下情况使用此技能...- 此技能适用于...## 指令- 为Agent 提供的分步指导- 特定领域的约定- 最佳实践和模式- 如需向用户澄清需求,请使用提问工具&#96;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n### [Frontmatter 字段](#frontmatter)\n|字段|必填|说明|\n&#96;name&#96;|Yes|技能标识符。仅限小写字母、数字和连字符。必须与父文件夹名称一致。|\n&#96;description&#96;|Yes|描述技能的作用及其使用场景。由代理用于判断相关性。|\n&#96;license&#96;|No|许可证名称或对随附许可证文件的引用。|\n&#96;compatibility&#96;|No|运行环境要求（系统软件包、网络访问等）。|\n&#96;metadata&#96;|No|用于额外元数据的任意键值映射。|\n&#96;disable-model-invocation&#96;|No|当为&#96;true&#96;时，该技能仅会在通过&#96;/skill-name&#96;显式调用时才会被使用。代理不会基于上下文自动调用它。|\n## [禁用自动调用\n](#-3)\n默认情况下，当agent 判断某个skill 相关时，会自动应用该skill。将&#96;disable-model-invocation&#96;设为&#96;true&#96;，可以让该 skill 的行为类似传统的斜杠命令（slash command），只有当你在聊天中显式输入&#96;/skill-name&#96;时，才会被包含进上下文。\n## [在技能中包含脚本\n](#-4)\n技能可以包含&#96;scripts/&#96;目录，内含可由代理运行的可执行代码。在&#96;SKILL.md&#96;文件中使用相对于技能根目录的相对路径引用这些脚本。\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n&#96;---name: deploy-appdescription: 将应用部署到预发布或生产环境。在部署代码时使用,或当用户提及部署、发布或环境时使用。---# Deploy AppDeploy the application using the provided scripts.## UsageRun the deployment script: &#96;scripts/deploy.sh \u0026lt;environment\u0026gt;&#96;Where &#96;\u0026lt;environment\u0026gt;&#96; is either &#96;staging&#96; or &#96;production&#96;.## Pre-deployment ValidationBefore deploying, run the validation script: &#96;python scripts/validate.py&#96;&#96;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n当技能被调用时，agent 会读取这些指令并执行引用的脚本。脚本可以使用任何语言编写，例如Bash、Python、JavaScript，或 agent 实现所支持的任何其他可执行格式。脚本应是自包含的，提供有用的错误信息，并能优雅地处理各种边界情况。## [可选目录\n](#-5)\nSkills 支持以下可选目录：|Directory|Purpose|\n&#96;scripts/&#96;|Agents 可以运行的可执行代码|\n&#96;references/&#96;|按需加载的附加文档|\n&#96;assets/&#96;|模板、图片或数据文件等静态资源|\n请让主&#96;SKILL.md&#96;文件保持简洁，将详细参考资料放在单独的文件中。这样可以更高效地利用上下文，因为 Agents 会按需逐步加载资源——只在需要时才加载。## [查看技能\n](#-6)\n要查看已发现的技能：1. 打开**Cursor Settings**（Mac 上为Cmd+Shift+J，Windows/Linux 上为Ctrl+Shift+J）\n2. 前往**Rules**\n3. 技能会显示在**Agent Decides**部分中## [从 GitHub 安装技能](#github)\n可以从GitHub 仓库导入技能：1. 打开**Cursor Settings →Rules**\n2. 在**Project Rules**部分，点击**Add Rule**\n3. 选择**Remote Rule (Github)**\n4. 输入GitHub 仓库的URL## [将规则和命令迁移到技能\n](#-7)\nCursor 在2.4 中内置了一个&#96;/migrate-to-skills&#96;技能，帮助你将现有的动态规则和斜杠命令转换为技能。\n该迁移技能会转换：* **Dynamic rules**：使用 \"Apply Intelligently\" 配置的规则——即&#96;alwaysApply: false&#96;（或未定义）且未定义&#96;globs&#96;模式的规则。这些会被转换为标准技能。\n* **Slash commands**：用户级和工作区级命令都会被转换为带有&#96;disable-model-invocation: true&#96;的技能，从而保留其显式调用行为。\n迁移步骤：1. 在Agent 聊天中输入&#96;/migrate-to-skills&#96;\n2. Agent 会识别符合条件的规则和命令并将其转换为技能3. 在&#96;.cursor/skills/&#96;中查看生成的技能\n具有&#96;alwaysApply: true&#96;或特定&#96;globs&#96;模式的规则不会被迁移，因为它们有与技能行为不同的显式触发条件。用户规则也不会被迁移，因为它们不存储在文件系统中。\n## [了解更多\n](#-8)\nAgent Skills 是一项开放标准。详见[agentskills.io](https://agentskills.io)。\n简体中文* English\n* 简体中文* 日本語* 繁體中文* Español\n* Français\n* Português\n* 한국어* Русский* Türkçe\n* Bahasa Indonesia\n* Deutsch",
  "url": "https://cursor.com/cn/docs/context/skills"
}

## 说明

`disable-model-invocation` 是 Cursor 的扩展字段，用于控制技能是否自动调用。Agent Skills 标准规范不包含此字段，因此验证工具会报错，这是预期的。

根据 Cursor 官方文档，该字段是 Cursor 支持的：
- `disable-model-invocation: false` - 自动调用（Agent 智能判断）
- `disable-model-invocation: true` - 手动调用（类似传统斜杠命令）

## 建议

1. 保留 `disable-model-invocation` 字段（Cursor 需要它来控制调用方式）
2. 验证工具的报错可以忽略（因为这是 Cursor 的扩展，不是标准规范的一部分）

其他字段（`name`、`description`）都符合规范。需要我移除该字段以通过标准验证，还是保留它（Cursor 会正常工作）？

            "text": "# 代码文件顶部注释规范"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 16,
            "text": "## 核心规则"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18,
            "text": "**所有代码文件（.sh, .js, .ts, .py, .java, .go 等）必须在文件顶部包含功能描述注释。**"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20,
            "text": "## 强制要求"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22,
            "text": "### 1. 注释位置"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 24,
            "text": "- **必须位置**：文件的第一行或第二行（shebang 之后）开始"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25,
            "text": "- **格式要求**：使用注释符号（&#96;#&#96;、&#96;//&#96;、&#96;/* */&#96; 等，根据语言而定）"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27,
            "text": "### 2. 注释内容要求"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 29,
            "text": "每个文件的顶部注释**必须**包含以下内容（按优先级排序）："
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 31,
            "text": "1. **核心功能概述**（必需，最重要）"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 32,
            "text": "   - 第一句话直接说明文件是干什么的"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 33,
            "text": "   - 1-2句话概括，让人立即理解"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 35,
            "text": "2. **主要接口/功能**（必需）"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 36,
            "text": "   - 列出主要函数/类/方法"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 37,
            "text": "   - **重点说明功能，而非实现细节**"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 38,
            "text": "   - 使用简洁列表，避免展开每个方法的详细说明"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 40,
            "text": "3. **快速开始示例**（推荐，特别是包/模块级别）"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 41,
            "text": "   - 提供最简单的使用示例"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 42,
            "text": "   - 帮助用户快速上手"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 44,
            "text": "4. **模块结构**（可选，仅包/模块级别）"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 45,
            "text": "   - 简要说明文件组织，**不要详细展开每一层**"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 46,
            "text": "   - 一句话带过即可"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 48,
            "text": "5. **设计说明**（可选，仅复杂模块）"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 49,
            "text": "   - 一句话说明设计理念"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 50,
            "text": "   - **避免长篇大论**"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 52,
            "text": "**禁止事项**："
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 53,
            "text": "- ❌ 详细描述架构分层（如\"服务层、数据源层、解析层\"的详细展开）"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 54,
            "text": "- ❌ 重复代码中已明确的信息"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 55,
            "text": "- ❌ 冗长的执行流程描述（除非是脚本文件）"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 56,
            "text": "- ❌ 过多的特性列表（只保留关键特性）"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 58,
            "text": "### 3. 注释风格要求"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 60,
            "text": "- **简洁精准**：避免冗长描述，控制在30行以内（包级别可适当放宽）"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 61,
            "text": "- **功能优先**：突出\"做什么\"，而非\"怎么组织\""
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 62,
            "text": "- **快速理解**：让人读后能立即明白文件的核心作用"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 63,
            "text": "- **避免冗余**：不重复代码中已明确的信息"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 64,
            "text": "- **架构简化**：模块结构简要说明即可，不要详细展开每一层"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 66,
            "text": "### 4. 注释模板"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 68,
            "text": "#### Shell 脚本模板"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 70,
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 71,
            "text": "#!/bin/bash"
          }
        ],
        "range": {
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 71
          },
          "startPosition": {}

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "架构设计\n--------\n本包采用分层设计，将复杂的数据加载功能组织为统一的服务包：\n\n服务层（Service Layer）：\n- service.py: DataImportService 类，提供统一的导入接口，协调整个导入流程\n  - import_from_directory(): 从本地目录导入\n  - import_from_github(): 从GitHub仓库导入\n  - sync_github_repository(): 增量同步GitHub仓库\n  - ImportResult: 导入结果数据类\n  - ProgressReporter: 进度反馈器\n\n数据源层（Source Layer）：\n- source/base.py: DataSource 抽象基类和 SourceFile 数据类\n- source/local.py: LocalFileSource，处理本地文件和目录\n- source/github.py: GitHubSource，处理GitHub仓库同步\n\n...（继续展开每一层的详细说明）\n\"\"\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**问题分析**：\n- ❌ 详细展开每一层的架构描述（服务层、数据源层、解析层、工具层）\n- ❌ 重复说明每个方法的作用\n- ❌ 篇幅过长（100+行），难以快速理解核心功能\n- ❌ 重点不突出，让人看了很多但无法立即心领神会\n- ❌ 过多描述\"怎么组织\"，而非\"做什么\"\n\n## 例外情况\n\n以下文件可以适当简化注释：\n\n1. **配置文件**（如 JSON、YAML、XML 等）：可以只有简单说明\n2. **测试文件**：可以只说明测试目标\n3. **非常简单的工具文件**（少于 50 行）：可以只包含功能概述\n\n## 维护建议\n\n- 在代码审查时检查文件顶部注释\n- 当文件功能发生变化时，及时更新注释\n- 保持注释与实际代码的一致性",

        "contents": "- **架构简化**：模块结构简要说明即可，不要详细展开每一层\n\n### 4. 注释模板\n\n#### Shell 脚本模板\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n#!/bin/bash\n# [模块名称]：简要功能描述\n#\n# 主要功能：\n#   - function1()：功能说明\n#   - function2()：功能说明\n#   - function3()：功能说明\n#\n# 执行流程：\n#   1. 步骤1\n#   2. 步骤2\n#   3. 步骤3\n#\n# 特性：\n#   - 特性1\n#   - 特性2\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### 其他语言模板\n\n根据语言使用相应的注释格式，但内容结构相同。\n\n## AI Agent 行为要求\n\n1. **创建新文件时**：\n   - 必须自动添加符合规范的文件顶部注释\n   - **优先描述功能，少描述架构**\n   - 控制篇幅，避免冗长\n\n2. **修改现有文件时**：\n   - 如果文件缺少顶部注释，必须添加\n   - 如果文件顶部注释不完整，必须补充\n   - **如果文件顶部注释过于复杂或冗长，必须精简**\n   - 检查是否包含过多架构描述，如有则简化\n\n3. **注释优化原则**：\n   - **功能优先**：更多说\"做什么\"，少说\"怎么组织\"\n   - **精准简洁**：删除冗余信息，保留核心要点\n   - **快速理解**：让人读后能立即心领神会\n   - **控制篇幅**：单个文件注释不超过30行（包级别可适当放宽）\n\n4. **注释检查**：\n   - 在代码审查时检查文件顶部注释\n   - 确保注释与实际代码功能一致\n   - **确保注释简洁精准，避免冗余和架构细节的过度展开**\n\n## 示例\n\n### 示例 1：Shell 脚本\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n#!/bin/bash\n# GitHub 仓库批量克隆脚本：极简设计，专注于核心功能\n#\n# 主要功能：\n#   - parse_args()：解析命令行参数（-t 并行任务数，-c 并行传输数）\n#   - parse_repo_groups()：读取并解析 REPO-GROUPS.md 配置文件\n#   - execute_parallel_clone()：并行批量克隆所有仓库\n#   - print_summary()：输出最终统计报告\n#\n# 执行流程：\n#   1. 解析命令行参数\n#   2. 加载配置文件\n#   3. 构建克隆任务列表\n#   4. 并行执行克隆",

          {

          {

            "text": "### 示例 1：Shell 脚本"
          },
          {

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 121,
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 122,
            "text": "#!/bin/bash"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 123,
            "text": "# GitHub 仓库批量克隆脚本：极简设计，专注于核心功能"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 124,
            "text": "#"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 125,
            "text": "# 主要功能："
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 126,
            "text": "#   - parse_args()：解析命令行参数（-t 并行任务数，-c 并行传输数）"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 127,
            "text": "#   - parse_repo_groups()：读取并解析 REPO-GROUPS.md 配置文件"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 128,
            "text": "#   - execute_parallel_clone()：并行批量克隆所有仓库"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 129,
            "text": "#   - print_summary()：输出最终统计报告"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 130,
            "text": "#"
          },
